description: Local signing daemon that holds private keys and signs transactions via Unix domain sockets. Key never leaves the vault process. Agents see only signed output.

components.name: vault-daemon
components.runs_as: Separate OS process with restricted permissions

architecture.data_flow: Agent → Unix socket → vault-daemon (signs) → signed_tx → Agent → broadcast
architecture.key_principle: Zero-knowledge agent — agent can request signatures but cannot extract or export keys

kognai_implementation_plan.key_storage: Encrypted JSON file, decrypted only in vault process memory
kognai_implementation_plan.agent_isolation: Each agent gets MOCK_WALLET_ADDRESS in .env, real signing routed through vault

security_properties: Key isolation: private key exists only in vault-daemon memory
No network exposure: Unix socket is local-only
Process isolation: vault runs as separate OS process
Audit trail: all sign requests logged with timestamp + agent ID
Key rotation: vault supports hot-swap without agent restart
